newsitem.title: USA: Duramed, Barr off again on FDA ruling.
newsitem.headline: Duramed, Barr off again on FDA ruling.

text.p: Duramed Pharmaceuticals Inc and Barr Laboratories Inc shares fell in early trading Tuesday after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration on Monday rejected Duramed's application to market a synthetic generic form of Premarin, an estrogen-replacement drug.
Shares in Cincinnati-based Duramed were off 5-7/8 to 4-1/2. Shares in Pomona, N.Y.-based Barr Laboratories Inc were off 2-1/4 to 41. Both stocks declined Monday, as well.
"It's a severe blow for Duramed," said Ohio Co industry analyst Eugene Robinson. "I don't know that a government agency has ever run a company into the ground like this before."
On Monday, the FDA said it will not approve synthetic generic forms of Premarin, which is produced as a brand-name drug by American Home Products Corp.
Duramed had filed a market-clearance application for a generic synthetic equivalent, as had Barr, the agency said.
The FDA said it would not approve the generic version because data do not show that it has the same active ingredients as American Home's brand name version, which is refined from horse urine.
Duramed and Barr could not be reached for comment.
